claims.text: The hotel's concept is 'Your Address in the Sky'.

findings.quote: “Your Address in the Sky”をコンセプトとするコンラッド大阪
findings.note: States the concept is 'Your Address in the Sky'.

claims.text: The hotel is directly connected to an Osaka Metro station.

findings.quote: 大阪メトロの駅にも直結しており
findings.note: Directly connected to an Osaka Metro station.

claims.text: Umeda and Namba are within walking distance of the hotel.

findings.quote: 梅田や難波も徒歩圏にあり
findings.note: Umeda and Namba are within walking distance.

claims.text: Kyoto is 15 minutes from Shin-Osaka by shinkansen.

findings.quote: 京都も新大阪より新幹線で15分の距離にあります。
findings.note: Kyoto is 15 minutes from Shin-Osaka by shinkansen.

claims.text: The interior design incorporates natural phenomena such as wind and light.

findings.quote: コンラッド大阪では風や光などの自然現象をインテリアデザインに取り入れています。
findings.note: The interior design incorporates natural phenomena such as wind and light.

claims.text: Conrad Spa takes the power of stones as its theme.

findings.quote: コンラッド・スパは石の力をテーマに
findings.note: The spa's theme is the power of stones.

claims.text: Conrad Spa offers Sisley treatments in collaboration with the French cosmetics brand Sisley.

findings.quote: フランスのハイエンド コスメティック ブランド「シスレー」とコラボレーションし、「シスレー トリートメント」をご提供しています。
findings.note: Sisley treatments are offered in collaboration with the French cosmetics brand.

claims.text: Daily wellness activities are offered for hotel guests.

findings.quote: 宿泊のお客様を対象としたデイリーアクティビティを用意しております。
findings.note: Daily activities for hotel guests are listed under the Wellness Activities heading.

claims.text: The Conrad Junior family plan includes a kids' tent in the room and use of the pool facilities.

findings.quote: お部屋のキッズテントやプール施設のご利用も含め
findings.note: The Conrad Junior plan includes a kids' tent in the room and use of the pool.

claims.text: The banquet rooms are pillarless with floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: 宴会場では床から天井までの高さがある窓から、最高の景色をお楽しみ下さい。柱のない広々とした宴会場では最新鋭機器も装備しており
findings.note: The banquet rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and no pillars.

claims.text: All guest rooms, restaurants, banquet rooms, the spa and fitness area, the indoor pool and meeting rooms look out over Osaka's skyline, rivers, the sea and distant mountains.

findings.quote: ホテルの全客室、レストラン、宴会場、スパ＆フィットネス、インドアプール、会議室などの全施設からは大阪のスカイラインや川、海、遠くには山々が見え
findings.note: All listed facilities have views of the skyline, rivers, sea and distant mountains.

claims.text: The 40th-floor lobby is welcomed by Fu/Rai's signature artwork inspired by Fujin and Raijin, the wind and thunder gods.

findings.quote: 40階のロビーフロアには風神雷神にインスパイアされたFu/Raiの代表的なアート作品が皆様をお迎えします。
findings.note: The 40th-floor lobby features Fu/Rai's signature artwork inspired by Fujin and Raijin.

claims.text: The spa has private treatment rooms, a jet bath and a couples spa, with views of the city.

findings.quote: プライベートトリートメントルーム、ジェットバス、カップル用スパもあり、ダイナミックな景色を見ながら
findings.note: The spa has private treatment rooms, a jet bath and a couples spa, with views.

claims.text: The hotel is in Nakanoshima Festival Tower West, with art, museums and concert halls adjacent.

findings.quote: コンラッド大阪は中之島フェスティバルタワー・ウエストに位置し、アート、ミュージアム、コンサートホールも隣接しており
findings.note: Located in Nakanoshima Festival Tower West, with art, museums and concert halls adjacent.

findings.quote: スパ＆フィットネス、インドアプール、会議室
findings.note: The pool is described as an indoor pool.

claims.text: Parking is available, with limited spaces.

findings.quote: 有（※台数に限りがございます）
findings.note: Parking is available, with limited spaces.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
